## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical debugging of a mesh egress scenario focusing on three concrete failure modes: gateway config, TLS trust, and DNS/external access. Requires use of container execs, SSL inspection, and rollback discipline.

## Key Concepts
- Consul Connect mesh egress gateway
